feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Tau-targeting pharmacological strategies in neurodegenerative disease.
drug.zh: 靶向病理tau而非全面降低tau，是tau蛋白病治疗策略优化的关键方向。

drug.title: Comparison of double-blind and open-label decline rates in lecanemab and donanemab trials in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 双盲与开放标签阶段斜率差异提示仑卡奈单抗长期获益或被高估。

drug.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
drug.zh: gantenerumab致脑实质体积减少主要源于淀粉样蛋白清除，而非ARIA。

drug.title: Real-world implementation of lecanemab in Korean patients at a tertiary memory clinic: Safety, ARIA risk, and early treatment patterns.
drug.zh: 韩国真实世界数据显示仑卡奈单抗输注相关反应常见但ARIA风险可控，早期治疗耐受性良好。

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217无法可靠监测donanemab治疗后淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916显著降低早期AD患者脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月未显著改善CDR-SB，ARIA发生率7.87%，停药主因经济负担。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样疗法资格，但需关注诊断延迟与MRI排除标准。

mech.title: Ferroptosis and NMDA Receptor Activity in Alzheimer's Disease: Implications for Amyloid Pathology and P-Glycoprotein Regulation.
mech.zh: 铁死亡与NMDA受体过度激活协同加剧Aβ沉积，并受P-糖蛋白调控，或为AD治疗新靶点。

mech.title: Engineering ApoE3-Targeted NIR-Responsive Liposomes for Multimodal Inhibition of Amyloid-β Aggregation and Acetylcholinesterase Activity.
mech.zh: ApoE3靶向近红外响应脂质体实现跨血脑屏障递送并协同抑制Aβ聚集与AChE活性。

mech.title: Bis(styryl)benzene Probes for Targeting Early-Stage Amyloid-β Aggregates in Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 双苯乙烯基苯探针可特异性识别早期Aβ聚集体，有望填补AD早期影像诊断空白。

mech.title: Multimerization of a rationally designed nanobody for enhanced avidity toward Aβ42 oligomers.
mech.journal: Protein science : a publication of the P
mech.zh: 理性设计的纳米抗体多聚化显著增强对Aβ42寡聚体的结合亲和力。

mech.title: Blood Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease and Gait Speed Trajectories in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Cohort Study.
mech.journal: Journal of cachexia, sarcopenia and musc
mech.zh: 血液AD生物标志物水平可预测社区老年人15年步速下降轨迹。

mech.title: [Immune Checkpoint Tim-3 Regulates Microglial Function in Alzheimer's Disease].
mech.journal: Brain and nerve = Shinkei kenkyu no shin
mech.zh: Tim-3缺失可增强小胶质细胞吞噬功能，减少Aβ沉积并改善AD小鼠认知。

mech.title: Characterization of [18F]SMBT-1 binding substrates in Alzheimer's disease and related disorders: A postmortem biochemical and immunohistochemical study.
mech.zh: [18F]SMBT-1在AD及非AD tau蛋白病中主要结合MAO-B而非Aβ或tau病理。

mech.title: Active Vaccination Strategies for Alzheimer's Disease: An Expanded Review.
mech.zh: 活性疫苗策略通过靶向Aβ和Tau蛋白，有望成为改变阿尔茨海默病病程的关键疗法。

dx.title: Blood Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease and Gait Speed Trajectories in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Cohort Study.
dx.journal: Journal of cachexia, sarcopenia and musc
dx.zh: 血液AD生物标志物水平可预测社区老年人15年步速下降轨迹。

dx.title: Interpretable Alzheimer's Diagnosis via Multimodal Fusion of Regional Brain Experts.
dx.zh: 提出多模态区域专家融合模型，借门控网络自适应加权生物标志物，提升AD诊断可解释性。

dx.title: Characterization of [18F]SMBT-1 binding substrates in Alzheimer's disease and related disorders: A postmortem biochemical and immunohistochemical study.
dx.zh: [18F]SMBT-1结合底物在AD及非AD tau蛋白病中与MAO-B而非Aβ或tau病理直接相关。

dx.title: Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Diagnostic Performance of Plasma p-tau217 and p-tau217/Aβ42 in Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217及其与Aβ42比值可精准预测Aβ-PET阳性，且纵向稳定性优于单独指标。

dx.title: The case for FDG-PET and NaF-PET in risk stratification of mild cognitive impairment.
dx.zh: 联合FDG-PET与NaF-PET可优化轻度认知障碍的风险分层，并识别可干预的血管钙化病变。

dx.title: A plasma-based protein signature combining NPTXR, ACHE, and p-tau217 predicts progression to symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 血浆NPTXR、ACHE联合p-tau217可显著提升无症状期向症状期AD进展的预测效能。

dx.title: Tracing neuroinflammation in neurodegeneration: insights from a scoping review on biofluid biomarkers.
dx.zh: 生物体液神经炎症标志物可追踪多种神经退行性疾病的诊断、预后与进展。

dx.title: Contribution of Myelin Content to the PET-Measured Amyloid Burden.
dx.journal: Journal of nuclear medicine : official p
dx.zh: 校正皮层内髓鞘含量可显著提升Aβ PET与血浆p-tau217的相关性。

prev.title: Life's Essential 8™ and incident dementia in an urban cohort: Findings from the Northern Manhattan Study.
prev.zh: 心血管健康评分每增10分，痴呆风险显著下降，LE8可作预防靶标。

prev.title: Association between different sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors and the risk of dementia: a network meta-analysis.
prev.zh: 网络荟萃分析显示，不同SGLT2抑制剂降低痴呆风险的效果存在差异。

prev.title: Urban-rural differences in health behaviors and cognition: Two Taiwanese older cohorts.
prev.journal: Journal of the Chinese Medical Associati
prev.zh: 台湾城乡老人健康行为与认知关联存在显著地域差异。

prev.title: Domain-specific physical activity levels and risk of dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
prev.zh: 不同领域体力活动与痴呆风险关联各异，休闲活动最显著降低风险。

prev.title: Digital Physical Exercise Interventions for Cognitive Functions in Older Adults: Systematic Review and Bayesian Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
prev.zh: 数字运动干预可改善老年人认知，虚拟现实结合认知训练效果最优。

prev.title: Midlife physical activity and late-life subjective cognitive complaints in women.
prev.zh: 中年女性体育锻炼量与晚年主观认知下降风险呈负相关。

prev.title: High-frequency taVNS modulates olfaction-related brain activity in patients with subjective cognitive decline.
prev.zh: 高频taVNS可即刻调节主观认知下降患者嗅觉相关脑区自发活动。

prev.title: Delirium superimposed on dementia in nursing homes: prevalence, incidence, and prognosis - protocol of a prospective multicenter cohort study.
prev.zh: 养老院痴呆患者谵妄叠加的患病率、发病率及预后数据仍属空白，本研究将填补该缺口。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑部疾病，目前看安全可行，但效果还在验证中，普通人了解个大概就行。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这药治早期老年痴呆效果还不确定，但能帮您和家人了解现在有啥选择，别白花冤枉钱。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，木头里的天然成分能多管齐下对付老年痴呆，对普通人来说，就是将来可能靠吃某些植物来防病或延缓病情。

intro.title: Oxidative Stress in Alzheimer's Disease: Can Dietary Interventions Provide Neuroprotection?
intro.zh: 人老了脑子生病，多半跟身体“生锈”有关，吃对东西也许能帮忙防一防。

intro.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
intro.zh: 抽血查老年痴呆越来越准了，但光靠化验单还不够，得先想清楚查完咋办，不然容易白花钱还添堵。

intro.title: Revisiting TREM2: from multi-omics signaling networks to clinical translation.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是免疫细胞上的一个“开关”TREM2，它在脑瘤和老年痴呆里作用相反，看懂它可能帮咱们找到更聪明的治疗办法。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差，帮你搞懂老年痴呆和帕金森病为啥都爱偷走记忆。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家在找能管住大脑里两种“捣乱酶”的药，用来减缓老年痴呆，帮病人多留住记忆和自理能力。
